66f1f0b6175cbc7a.description: HRIS Analyst Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 4 to 6 Years Immediate to 30 Days Shift: US Shift / Night Shift - 5PM to 2AM IST Work Model: 4 Days Work From Office, 1 Day Work From Home. At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core back-office functions in the insurance domain. We are seeking a detail-oriented and service-driven HRIS Analyst to support the ongoing administration and maintenance of our Human Resource Information System, with primary responsibility for UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) Core HR and Workforce Management systems. This role is responsible for ensuring employee data accuracy, processing system updates, managing HRIS tickets, and providing timely support to employees and managers. Serve as system analyst for UKG (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Workforce Management, Recruitment, Onboarding, Document Manager modules). Ensure data accuracy through routine audits and reconciliation activities. Support payroll processing by validating employee data prior to payroll deadlines. Ticket Management & Employee Support Work with IT and other internal and external teams for issue resolution. Provide timely, accurate support to employees and managers regarding: Employee data updates Escalate complex issues to HRIS Director and coordinate with HR, Payroll, IT, or UKG Support as appropriate. Data Integrity & Compliance Perform regular data audits to ensure system accuracy and compliance. Reconcile HRIS data with payroll and benefits providers. Support internal and external audit requests. Maintain strict confidentiality and data privacy standards. Reporting Support Generate standard and ad-hoc reports from UKG to support HR and business leaders. Validate data outputs prior to distribution.
